load_obl_model: load the OBL pretrained Hanabi SAD model from a .pthw checkpoint file
create_R2D2Agent: create an R2D2Agent with online and target LSTM networks for Hanabi reinforcement learning
run_greedy_act: run greedy action selection on private and public state tensors using the online network
run_act_eps_greedy: run epsilon-greedy action selection on observation dict with private state, public state, and legal moves
review_duel_q_value: review the duel Q-value computation that combines value and advantage networks with legal move masking
